verdicts.reason: A keeps the logo at a readable size and holds the headline and CTA together as one block. But that block sits around 57% down the canvas, below the glow it was centred on in the original. That leaves a dead lower third, and bokeh dots crowd the gap between the headline and the CTA. B shrinks the SOLSTICE wordmark and sun until they are barely legible. Its headline sits even further below the glow, with a bokeh dot touching it, and the CTA is pushed almost to the bottom and cut off from the headline. That breaks the grouping and leaves a big empty middle.
